Our Specialities

We focus on three areas — physiotherapy, orthopaedics and general surgery — supported by the departments a hospital needs around them.

Centres of excellence

Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation

Restore movement after injury, surgery or stroke — at the hospital or in your home.

8 specialistsExplore

Orthopaedics

Joint replacement, fracture care, spine and sports injury treatment.

6 specialistsExplore

General Surgery

Laparoscopic and open surgery with structured pre- and post-operative care.
